task.title: Install the Fence Agents Remediation Operator by using the CLI
task.shortdesc: You can use the OpenShift CLI (oc) to install the Fence Agents Remediation Operator.

ul.li: Log in as a user with cluster-admin privileges.

context.p: You can install the Fence Agents Remediation Operator in your own namespace or in the openshift-workload-availability namespace.

step.cmd: Create a Namespace custom resource (CR) for the Fence Agents Remediation Operator:

substep.cmd: Define the Namespace CR and save the YAML file, for example, workload-availability-namespace.yaml:

info.codeblock: apiVersion: v1 kind: Namespace metadata: name: openshift-workload-availability

substep.cmd: To create the Namespace CR, run the following command:
Define the OperatorGroup CR and save the YAML file, for example, workload-availability-operator-group.yaml:

info.codeblock: apiVersion: operators.coreos.com/v1 kind: OperatorGroup metadata: name: workload-availability-operator-group namespace: openshift-workload-availability

substep.cmd: To create the OperatorGroup CR, run the following command:
Define the Subscription CR and save the YAML file, for example, fence-agents-remediation-subscription.yaml:

info.codeblock: apiVersion: operators.coreos.com/v1alpha1 kind: Subscription metadata: name: fence-agents-remediation-subscription namespace: openshift-workload-availability spec: channel: stable name: fence-agents-remediation source: redhat-operators sourceNamespace: openshift-marketplace

ul.li: namespace: Specify the Namespace where you want to install the Fence Agents Remediation Operator, for example, the openshift-workload-availability outlined earlier in this procedure. You can install the Subscription CR for the Fence Agents Remediation Operator in the openshift-workload-availability namespace where there is already a matching OperatorGroup CR.

substep.cmd: To create the Subscription CR, run the following command:

ol.li: Verify that the installation succeeded by inspecting the CSV resource: $ oc get csv -n openshift-workload-availabilityNAME DISPLAY VERSION REPLACES PHASE fence-agents-remediation.v0.3.0 Fence Agents Remediation Operator 0.3.0 fence-agents-remediation.v0.2.1 Succeeded

Verify that the Fence Agents Remediation Operator is up and running: $ oc get deployment -n openshift-workload-availabilityNAME READY UP-TO-DATE AVAILABLE AGE fence-agents-remediation-controller-manager 2/2 2 2 110m
